summary: HWH International Inc. filed Form 8-K disclosing entry into a term sheet with Smart Dynamics Technology Limited for a $10 million private investment in public equity (PIPE) via Regulation S. Terms include sale of 20 million newly issued shares and warrants for 160 million shares at $0.63 per share, exercisable for four years. Investor gains anti-dilution rights for two years and may appoint three directors. Closing requires stockholder majority approval. A prior planned acquisition of Hapi Metaverse Inc. by majority stockholder Alset Inc. was terminated. This is a capital raise, not a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. Watch for definitive agreements and shareholder vote.
